dispatch.summary:
Finding 2 is fixed and the task-tier check passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n and 1,453 affected unit tests (lint failed once on an unused import and passed after it was removed).
The buyer's search now starts at a wage ceiling: the highest OVR whose market wage, at the cheapest age (14 or 41) with no promise, fits the buyer's headroom. It reads down each indexed list and stops only when no remaining player could beat both the need's threshold and the targets already kept at that slot. The fixed 24-entry depth is gone. Each candidate is checked for affordability (his wage plus the lowest possible bid) without firing the wage-decision observer.
Two new unit tests cover the reviewer's boundaries. Both fail on the previous engine and pass now:
- An affordable 40-year-old rated 88 is bought, although the old estimate cut him off.
- A slot fit rated 82 is bought past 30 abler players who rate only 78.2 at that slot.
The day-loop equivalence tests pass (11) after regenerating the throughput signature (9581b43fe497276a → 8268a8e9573aa5ea) and tests/fixtures/portable-v1.json. Both 8-seed, 5-season measurements were re-run and recorded in T945's result. The bands barely moved, and fresh-1995 CPU time is unchanged at 322 s.
Finding 1 is blocked. The reviewer asks that a buyer can still bid on later settlement days, and that a higher-stature club is not beaten by a lower one's earlier meeting day. The current one seeded meeting day per buyer-player pair follows the coordinator's directive, and lifting it needs a decision only the planner can make. The code keeps the directed per-pair day for now.

reviewHistory.summary: The pinned submission has market and measurement contract violations. The worker reported passing task-tier checks and measurements; the shared final gate remains deferred to the coordinator.

findings.message: The tried set is recreated on every settlement day, so a buyer can bid for the same player again after a refusal in the same window. The test at npc-market.unit.test.ts:409 explicitly exercises this behavior, but T945 requires one bid per target per window. Prevent repeat bids within a window while preserving the specified seeded draws and bid cap.

XI losses are captured before liveHistory performs the season close. A season-start starter who retires, is released, or returns from a loan at that close is therefore omitted from the total XI losses reported for the season. Capture losses after the close while retaining the season-start club identities, and verify the resulting measurement used by T945.

The snapshot key replaces every non-alphanumeric seed character with an underscore without retaining or checking the original seed. For example, seed prefixes 'a/' and 'a_' produce the same filename for seed 0, so a later lived run can silently load the other seed's world despite a valid checksum. Encode or hash the complete seed in the key and verify distinct seeds cannot reuse a snapshot.

The harness rejects every --owner argument, although T944 specifies an owner world when --owner <club id> is supplied. Implement that start mode so the requested occasional owner-world measurements can run, or hand the scope gap back for a planning decision.

reviewHistory.summary: The prior review corrections are present, but the NPC market still excludes eligible targets in ways that violate T945’s buyer-selection contract. Worker task-tier checks and measurements were reviewed; the coordinator host owns the final gate.

findings.message: A buyer can meet a target only on one randomly assigned settlement day. If its need or funding becomes available after that day, it cannot bid for that player during the rest of the window, even when he is its best reachable target. The same restriction lets a lower-stature buyer acquire a player before a higher-stature interested buyer’s assigned day. T945 requires selection on each settlement day and WORLD-16 gives a contested player to the higher-stature club. Track window attempts without excluding untried targets on later days, and cover a need opening after the first settlement and competing buyers.

The candidate index discards everyone above an estimated regular’s affordable level plus six and stops after 24 main-OVR entries per division before ranking by slot gain. An affordable older player above that estimate, or a better slot fit below those 24 entries, is never considered even when he is the best reachable target. T945 requires buyers to choose by slot gain within reach and means. Preserve the indexed search while ensuring eligible candidates can compete on actual affordability and slot rating, with coverage for both boundaries.

findings.message: The new relegated-starter and above-division factors are populated only by npcSaleContext. When our top-flight club bids for the same qualifying NPC seller's starter, saleContext supplies no npc rows, omitting both −0.10 adjustments. An isolated reproduction returned both factors through npcSaleContext and neither through saleContext. CLUB-52 defines these factors by the NPC seller's circumstances, regardless of buyer ownership. Share the seller facts with the owned-buyer path and cover that path with a regression.

The submitted algorithm has only a four-seed, two-season lived:1951 smoke and no updated modern measurement; the reported cost comparison also predates decision A. Rerun both required harness workloads on this candidate and update the statistics and settlement-cost evidence before marking this acceptance complete.

findings.message: Candidates check only the total ceiling, ignoring the league's counted-player limit. Reproduced with an Italian third-tier club in 2021: 24 counted players became 26 after drawing two prodigies, exceeding its allowed 24 because this league has no youth exemption. Apply the counted/exempt arrival check used by intakeNpcYouth and choose another eligible club when registration would exceed the limit. Add a regression case for this league.

reviewHistory.summary: The prior registration-limit finding is addressed, but promotion timing and wartime academy placement still violate the task contracts. The worker’s task-tier checks passed; the shared final gate remains with the coordinator.

findings.message: Facility levels follow the old division at the season close because booksClose runs before applyPromotion in season.ts. A promoted or relegated club therefore starts its new division with levels adjusted against its previous target, and the new target is not applied until the following close. This can even move a level in the wrong direction during relegation. Apply the level adjustment after promotion using the new division while retaining the closing season’s financial calculation, and cover the real season-close ordering.

A prodigy placed in the owner’s academy at the 1938 close or during a skipped war summer receives no development or academy decisions during the gap. In particular, a prodigy drawn for 1939 reaches the 1946 restart aged 21 and is released by seasonAcademy without ever training or having a chance to be promoted. NPC prodigies develop at each skipped close. Handle owner-academy prodigies through the war gap so their development and eligibility do not disappear, and verify a placement across the 1939–1946 transition.

reviewHistory.summary: The promotion-timing correction is present, but the wartime prodigy handling still violates T947 and WORLD-18. The coordinator owns the final verification gate.

findings.message: Excluding the owner's club from every 1939–1945 draw changes the required weighted placement: WORLD-18 and T947 include the owner's club each summer. It also leaves the original lifecycle problem for a prodigy placed in the academy for 1938: crossWar gives him no academy development or promotion decision, and seasonAcademy releases him at the 1946 restart. Preserve eligible owner placement and handle academy prodigies across the gap, including one already present before it.

During a skipped summer, ordinary intake first refills squads to 22, then drawProdigies can add another youth to a squad already at or above that size. **F1 (T948, `delegation.ts`):** `runwayCheck` now keeps the reserve on current annual fixed costs, as ECON-33 says. A new commitment's wage only raises the planned loss; it no longer adds to the reserve as well. `wageRoom` follows from this, so the plan's carried wage bill and the room for raises also change. In the review's example (step 2, a 균형형 단장, income equal to fixed costs, 10,000 of capital), the raise room is now 1,666 and 1,667 fails. That replaces the earlier 1,538. I updated the test in `delegation.test.ts`, and the cash set-up in `signings.test.ts` no longer puts the wage into the reserve.

**F2 (T949, `signings.ts`):** each day, before any ordinary move, `staffSignings` now raises every negotiator bid that was refused on an earlier day: one per player, on his latest bid. It stops when the pending bids reach the step's count, and any left over wait for the next day. Off a regular look, the 단장 goes on to ordinary moves only when one of those haggles ended without a raise. A new test in `director-bidding.test.ts` refuses two bids on the same day at 아낌없이. It checks that both are raised to 95% the next day, ahead of ordinary moves.

**A failing integration test I also fixed:** `transfers.delegated.test.ts` already failed on 81046c88 and passes on the base 689ba861. With the lane's buying every 3 days from the scout's whole reach, seed `market-1`'s season gets 8 incoming bids and all are accepted, so there is no refusal to check. findings.message: ECON-33 defines the reserve from current annual fixed costs, then tests the planned loss after the commitment against that available capital. Process all due retries within the applicable pending limit before making ordinary moves, and cover simultaneous rejections.

The harness is scripts-only, with no engine source changes. `scripts/market-seasons.ts` is the CLI, `scripts/lib/market-seasons.ts` holds the pure parsing, aggregation and merge, and `scripts/lib/start-worlds.ts` is the gzipped start-world store under `.tmp/market-seasons/`, with a sha256 check and an entry cap. `scripts/lib/market-seasons.test.ts` has 20 unit tests, including the world round-trip. `vibe check --tier task` passed (typecheck, lint, format, i18n, affected units) and acceptance is ticked. I did not run `lived:` reads or an 8-seed 5-season read; T945 measures those.

Smoke results:
- **Fresh start:** `--start fresh:1951 --burn-in 2 --seasons 2 --seeds 0..1 --jobs 2` wrote the JSON in 61 s. The first fresh season made 0 moves. Later seasons made about 1,150–1,200 paid, 65–165 free and 90–180 loan moves.
- **`lived:1951`:** the first build took 133 s and stored a 3 MB snapshot. A second run loaded it, and a season then took 3 s.
- **Options:** `--lucks`, `--config` and `--merge` ran. `--config` echoes the applied values, e.g. `{"NPC_MARKET":{"moves":4}}` moved season-1 paid moves from 908 to 1064. A fresh start with `--burn-in 1` is refused.

Limits:
- **Owner worlds:** `--owner <club id>` is not implemented; the flag is refused with the usage message.
- **Reasons:** they are inferred from exported engine reads and labelled inferred. The observer's optional reason argument (from T945) is counted only if it is a string.
- **`--config` timing:** a `lived:` or `file:` start applies the config after the start world is built, so the snapshot is always the default-config world. A fresh start applies it before the world is made.
- **Finding for T945/T950:** in the smoke, about 85% of paid moves cross countries (994 of 1,153 in one season). The current market has no domestic preference.
- **Not run:** builds, integration and full suites, left to the shared final gate.

dispatch.summary:
T948 is done. The 단장 now plans spending against how long the club's cash can cover a planned loss (ECON-33 r62), instead of against a share of income. The planned loss is fixed costs (player wages included) minus planned income, floored at zero. A commitment passes when its fee plus the planned loss after it, times the step's runway (none/6/4/2/1 seasons), fits the cash left above the reserve. The reserve uses the new temperament rows. At step 1 the loss after the commitment must be zero.

`delegation.ts` gains `plannedLoss`, `runwayTest` and fractional reserves, and the plan now carries runway, fixed costs, loss and seasons covered. The old share constants (SQUAD_SHARE, REINVEST_SHARE, SELL_LINE, SELL_STEP) are gone.

- **Signings:** `planRoomAfterWage` and `signingVerdict` keep their call shape and now apply the runway test exactly. signings.ts itself is untouched.
- **Renewals:** read the runway test with the raise, and 짠물 applies while the test fails at the current wage bill.
- **Selling harder:** `wagePressure` now reads the sales step's runway test: level 2 when it fails at half the runway, level 1 when it fails at the full runway. The sale answer's −0.05/−0.10 rows and CLUB-24's −25 point price drop now trigger on these levels.
- **Pages:** the budget page, the delegation plan views and the ClubStaff lines show '적자 허용: 현금으로 N시즌' or '수입 안에서 운영', plus how many seasons the cash covers.
- **Messages:** 27 new IDs with translations in all 12 packs. 17 UI-only IDs are removed, including 'budget.plans.wageCap' and 'budget.plans.sellLine'. IDs the engine writes into saves are kept, per ARCH-32.

**Checks:** the task-tier gate passed (typecheck, lint, format, validate:i18n, 300 affected unit files / 2658 tests). I also ran a few integration files once: the day-loop equivalence tests (calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput) pass with no fixtures regenerated, and transfers.stance, transfers.incoming, contracts and signings all pass after updating their tests.

**Left for the next tasks:**
- **T949:** `signingVerdict`'s messages still describe a share of income (the share now prints as 0). `moneyBar` reads the new fee room. The signings offer line still says "7일마다".
- **T945:** sale-answer.ts's 'market.sale.wages.*' lines still describe a share of income, though the rows themselves now follow the runway test.

**Coordinator gate:** the browser journeys that touch the budget page are work-office, business, owner-sheet, club-identity-management and rules-three-owner. No Playwright was run locally.

dispatch.summary:
T946 구현 완료. 동작 변경 세 가지와 화면 수정 하나입니다.

- 창단 기준: 각 리그의 기준 능력치를 `divisionLevel`로 80/70/60/50(90−10t)으로 바꿨고, 창단 구단은 여기에 stature ±3을 더합니다(15–92 범위). 시장 가격이 쓰는 `tierLevel`은 그대로 두어 CLUB-25/46은 바뀌지 않습니다.
- 시설 레벨: 구단 없는 클럽의 시설 레벨이 소속 리그를 따라갑니다. 목표는 `facilityStage`(리그 기준값 + stature)이고, 레벨은 시즌당 최대 `moveAfterChange`(1)만큼 움직입니다. 잉여 투자는 목표보다 최대 `aboveTarget`(1) 위까지만 올립니다. 위치는 persisted-squads.ts의 `followLevels`이고, books.ts의 기존 `investNpcLevels`를 대체합니다.
- 유스 잠재력: 중심값은 `divisionLevel` + (아카데미 레벨 − 리그 기준 아카데미 레벨) × `divisionCentre`(3)입니다. 분포는 `NPC_YOUTH.skew` 분위표로 정해지며, 2/3는 중심 아래, 1/3은 중심 이상, 5%는 +10 이상입니다. 보충 영입 유스는 기준값 −`refillBelow`(10)을 중심으로 뽑습니다. 영입 인원, 나이, PRNG 키와 추첨 순서는 그대로입니다.
- 인수 목록은 구단 없는 클럽의 저장된 `club.strength`를 보여 줍니다.

측정(1930→1951, 시드 3개, 대조군 대비): LEAGUE-10의 ±3 밴드 안에 든 국가/리그 칸이 147칸 중 10–11 → 54–61로 늘었습니다. 1935년 이후 시즌 개막 때 1부 밖 85 초과 칸은 66–75 → 1–3개가 됐습니다. 1951년 1부 평균은 약 80이지만 3·4부는 아직 기준보다 +4~+10 높고, 1930년대에는 모든 리그가 4–18 높게 올라갑니다. 유스 영입은 원인이 아닙니다(각 리그 기준보다 4–5 낮게 유지). 남은 원인은 창단 선수의 잠재력 여유(flat 10–35)와 하위 리그가 상위 리그 선수를 흡수하는 흐름으로 보이며, T950에서 조정할 몫입니다. `SQUAD_SPREAD` 'spread' 변형은 61–67칸으로 효과가 작고, WORLD-6 게이트가 적용 전에 막고 있어 'flat'을 유지했습니다. 1951년 임금 합계는 대조군 대비 0.64/0.45/0.29/0.22–0.29배, 가치 합계는 0.49/0.37/0.29/0.21배입니다.

다시 만든 고정값: tests/fixtures/portable-v1.json(기대값만 갱신), full-model-throughput의 `BEFORE` 다이제스트(aggregateRecords efb1b0e2dc8517ba, candidateRounds a00032e27765d38e).

함께 고친 테스트:
- history.test: 창단 능력치 검증을 `divisionLevel` 기준으로 변경.
- club-staff.test: 계약금 기대값이 내림(wage/4)이었는데 코드는 반올림(`ratio`)이라, 스태프 능력치가 바뀌면서 드러났습니다. 기대값을 `ratio`로 맞췄습니다.

검사 결과:
- `vibe check --tier task` 통과: typecheck, lint, format, i18n, 영향 받은 단위 테스트 1422개(tree 7f92831b).
- 통합: calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput, persisted-world.integration, history 통과.
- 계약: portable 6/6 통과.

dispatch.summary:
T945 is implemented and the task-tier check passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n, and 2,688 affected unit tests in 301 files.

**What changed**
- **Pull market:** clubs nobody owns now buy by need, in stature order. Each picks up to 2 targets from a searchable index of reachable players: its own country's division and those below, a higher division only on loan, and other top flights on a seeded day.
- **Bids and answers:** the bid is the asking fee times a seeded share (0.5–1); a buyer holding 3× the fee bids the full asking fee. The seller answers through CLUB-52 and the player through CLUB-53, each with its own seeded draw. The seller's answer gains the relegated-starter and above-division rows, and contract rows count half before 1995.
- **Era caps:** bids, buys and sales per club and window follow the new era table (1950: 3/2/2 up to 2010: 8/5/5).
- **Sell-down order:** lowest value per wage, then aged 30+, then final contract season, then highest wage.
- **Move reasons:** the move observer now receives a reason for every move kind, and nothing new is stored in the save.

**Tests**
- New unit tests cover:
  - a bid at or above the reservation is bought and one below it refused;
  - the seller's counter;
  - the player refusing by his CLUB-53 draw;
  - the relegated-starter and above-division rows;
  - the pre-1995 half;
  - the era caps;
  - the sell-down order;
  - a reason for every move kind;
  - nothing stored without an observer;
  - the CLUB-52/53 draw keys, and that adding a factor never shifts another answer's draw.
- I ran the three day-loop equivalence tests once. `calendar.progression-eng` and `season` pass. `full-model-throughput` passes after I regenerated its signature.

**Fixtures regenerated by this change**
- `tests/fixtures/portable-v1.json`: the same command on the unchanged base produced no diff, so the whole change comes from T945.
- `full-model-throughput.test.ts` candidate-rounds signature: `aef5e3c0618eb5f2` → `a05cbbd0c13eeb52`.
- `owned-loan-return.unit.test.ts` loan digest: its setup now makes the young listed keeper the only one on offer.

**Measured against the scout's bands** (8 seeds, 5 seasons each; reported, not gated):

| Start | Fee moves in / out per top-flight club (p50) | Season-start XI lost (by fee) | Lower-division top-3 moving up |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lived:1951` | 3.0→1.9 / 2.8→1.3 — inside the 2–4 band, falling each season | 0.65–0.93 — below 2–3 (by fee also under 0.8–1.5) | 4–5% — well below 20–30% |
| fresh 1995 | 5.8–6.5 / 5.0–6.3 — above the 3–6 band (the 2010 cap of 8) | 1.55–1.89 by fee — inside 1–2 | 4–7% — well below 40–60% |

Division strength means were 88/84/83/82 on `lived:1951` and 83/72/62/54 on fresh 1995. The lived worlds' divisions are compressed, which is T946's area. Cross-country moves dropped from about 85% of paid moves under the old market to about 5%. A season takes about 3 s.

**Limits**
- **One bid per target per window:** this holds only within a settlement day. Remembering bids across a window's three days would need new saved state, outside the files this task may touch. The window's total bid cap does hold exactly.
- **Pre-1995 half:** it applies only between clubs nobody owns. Our own club's answers are unchanged, as the task notes asked, although the CLUB-52 table states the half for every seller.
- **Files changed outside the task's scope:**
  - two new factor messages (`market.sale.relegated`, `market.sale.aboveDivision`) in `source-messages.ts` and all 12 locale packs;
  - the three regenerated fixtures above.
- **Not run here:** `pnpm run verify:batch`, the portable contract test, and the other integration files that live NPC transfer windows. These are left to the shared final gate.

dispatch.summary:
T947 구현을 마쳤습니다. 검사는 모두 통과했습니다.

**신동 (새 파일 packages/engine/src/prodigies.ts)**
- 매 여름 마감에 신동을 1명 또는 2명 뽑습니다. 2명일 확률은 0.5입니다.
- 나이 14, OVR 57–63, 잠재력 88–96이고, 전용 스트림(`<seed>:prodigy:<year>`)을 써서 다른 추첨은 바뀌지 않습니다.
- 배치 가중치는 (아카데미 레벨 + 1) × (1 + 양의 stature/10)입니다. 구단주 없는 클럽에는 스쿼드 선수로, 구단주 클럽에는 아카데미 U-17(무급)로 들어갑니다. 대표 클럽에는 배치하지 않습니다.
- 선수에 `prodigy?: true` 필드를 추가했습니다. 브리프 범위 밖인 contracts의 types.ts와 schema.ts 두 파일도 수정했습니다.
- 성장은 18세 전까지 3배이고, 그 상한도 3배입니다(라운드 성장 0.12, 시즌 성장 3). training.ts의 라운드·시즌 성장과 academy.ts의 아카데미 성장에 모두 적용했습니다.

**전쟁 공백기 (npc-careers.ts)**
- 건너뛴 여름에는 아카데미 정원만큼 뽑지 않고, 스쿼드 기본 인원·포지션 최소 인원·골키퍼까지만 채웁니다.
- T916 시드에서 1946 개막 스쿼드는 평균 22.2명, 최대 28명입니다. 대조군은 평균 38.1명(최대 40), T946은 36.1명이었습니다.

**측정**
- 신동 88명에게 3시즌 성장 규칙을 돌리면 55명(62.5%)이 16세까지 OVR 80을 넘었습니다.

**검사**
- `vibe check --tier task`: 단위 테스트 1583개 통과(tree 104311f8). 새 prodigies.test.ts 7개 포함.
- 통합 테스트 24개 통과: 일자 루프 동등성 3종, wartime, wartime-employment, persisted-world, history.
- 포터블 골든과 full-model-throughput 다이제스트는 바뀌지 않아 다시 만들 필요가 없었습니다. 둘 다 여름 마감을 지나지 않기 때문입니다.

dispatch.summary:
T949 is done. A funded delegated club now spends to sign the best players it can afford, and the task-tier checks pass.

What changed in the 단장's buying:
- **Looks:** he looks every 3rd day (`SIGNING_CONFIG.lookDays` 3).
- **Pending bids:** each look keeps making moves until his pending bids reach the step's count: 1 up to 적당히, 2 at 넉넉히, 3 at 아낌없이 (`pendingByStep`). Each pending fee is held back from the available capital. A need that a pending bid's player would already fill is skipped, so he does not bid twice for one place.
- **Where candidates come from:** the manager's pick first, then the shortlist, then everyone within the scout's reach (new `reachOffers` in scout-search.ts).
- **Upgrades at 넉넉히/아낌없이:** after the manager's pick, everyone in reach is ranked by how far he beats the slot's starter. A bid for a player who is not on the shortlist goes through the existing world-market target.
- **Money bar:** a 27-year-old's market wage times (the step's loss runway + 1) must fit the capital the runway test leaves.
- **Upgrade cap:** at 넉넉히 the number of XI slots below the bar now raises the window's cap, as it already did at 아낌없이.
- **Listing weak players:** a weak non-starter is listed by the money-bar rule only once a signing for his line has joined in this window.
- `signingVerdict` now applies the runway test directly. director-bidding.ts needed no change.

Reference careers (York Mill A1, English second tier, every decision delegated, both requests at 5, £15.7M added to cash directly rather than as an injection, two seasons; same probe run on bad91b7c):

| Career | Bought / sold (before) | Bought / sold (now) | XI mean slot OVR, start → after each window (now) | Fees paid (now) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1951 | 15 / 18 | 24 / 21 | 61.1 → 74.2 → 82.0 → 82.2 → 82.6 (before: 61.8 → 76.8) | £159K (before £100K) |
| 2005 | 14 / 18 | 28 / 23 | 61.0 → 67.1 → 70.6 → 74.4 → 78.9 (before: 59.9 → 68.6) | dearest £8.54M, OVR 84 |

In 1951, fees of £6–10K buy players of OVR 85–86, so most of the £15.7M stays unspent because there is nothing dearer to buy. The 1951 baseline here is a fresh probe world, not your own save (which read 10 bought, 13 sold, £92,831). One window ran the other way: the 1951 window after promotion sold 11 and bought 8.

**Checks:**
- **Task tier:** `vibe check --tier task` passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n, and 1417/1417 affected unit tests.
- **Integration files run once locally:** signings 44/44 (includes the new cases for the 3-day looks, pending count, reach ranking, 넉넉히 cap and line-joined listing), plus mediation-resolution, replacements, responsibility-routing and delegation, all passing.
- **Day-loop equivalence:** calendar.progression-eng, season and full-model-throughput pass, with no fixtures regenerated.
- **Scout search:** scout-search 25/25, including a new reach test.

**Limits:**
- The copy 'delegation.offer.signings' still says "7일마다". Fixing it means editing source-messages and every locale pack, which are outside this task's files, so it needs a follow-up.
- I updated signings.test.ts and scout-search.test.ts, which are also outside the listed files, to match the new look.

findings.message: Candidates check only the total ceiling, ignoring the league's counted-player limit. Reproduced with an Italian third-tier club in 2021: 24 counted players became 26 after drawing two prodigies, exceeding its allowed 24 because this league has no youth exemption. Apply the counted/exempt arrival check used by intakeNpcYouth and choose another eligible club when registration would exceed the limit. Add a regression case for this league.

findings.message: Rounding slot gain changes CLUB-33's candidate order. With seed 'staff-signings', no manager pick and recruitment at step 5, the director bids for a player rated 55.73 at the slot while an affordable 56.27 candidate remains available: both gains round to 15. Rank by the unrounded gain and make the regression test compare actual slot values.

The displayed wage budget and contracts raise room ignore the additional reserve required by the raise. With income equal to current fixed costs, step 2, a balanced director and 10,000 minor units of available capital, contracts.left reports 1,666, but runwayTest rejects that raise; the actual maximum is 1,538. Derive the advertised room from the same commitment calculation used for acceptance.

A runway refusal still uses delegation.verdict.squadBudget, which claims fee plus one year's wage exceeds plan.left. Reproduced at step 2 with left=10,000, fee=5,000 and wage=1,500: rejection correctly follows the six-season runway, but the explanation falsely says 6,500 exceeds 10,000. Add a runway-specific refusal resource in every locale, retaining the historical resource for supported saves.

Confirmed delegation.offer.signings still says '7일마다', with the equivalent seven-day claim in all 12 locale packs. OfferAnswers also supplies the fixed upgrade count despite the new money-bar cap. Update this live explanation to describe three-day looks, the step's pending-bid limit and the expanded upgrade cap, using named parameters and translations throughout.

New fractional coverage and reserve values bypass the shared number formatters here and at line 108. sourceMessage stringifies them before localizeValue, so de-DE displays '3.5 Spielzeiten' and '0.25 Jahre' instead of localized decimal separators. Format these numbers at the presentation boundary with the shared decimal formatter.

planRoomAfterWage has no production callers after this lane; only tests exercise it. The refunded parameter chain also remains despite becoming a documented no-op. Consider removing these obsolete interfaces to avoid maintaining redundant budget APIs.

dispatch.summary:
All six review findings are fixed, as the coordinator resolved them. The task-tier check passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n, and 2,691 affected unit tests in 301 files.

**T945 engine**
- **(1) One answer per pair per window:** the bid, the seller's draw and the player's draw are now keyed `<seed>:npc-bid|npc-sale|npc-terms:<year>:<summer|winter>:<buyer>:<player>`. A pair asked again later in the same window meets the same draws, with no new saved state.
- **(2) Search quota:** a player whose club cannot sell now (sales cap reached, or the sale is blocked) is skipped before he uses one of the 24 search places. The new test fails with the check removed and passes with it.
- **(3) Pre-1995 half:** CLUB-52's contract rows now count half before 1995 for every seller, our club included; `saleContext` passes the year.

**T944 harness**
- **(4) Snapshots:** each writer stages its own uniquely named temp files and publishes them by rename. Jobs are grouped by seed, so a lived start is built once per seed (checked: one build for seed 0 with two lucks).
- **(5) `--config`:** the tunables now live in a new registry file, `scripts/lib/market-tunables.ts`. It includes the era caps (`NPC_MARKET_ERA`, now `{anchors}`) and the CLUB-52/53 values (`SALE_SHARE`, `SALE_FACTOR_VALUES`, `TERMS_VALUES`). It resets to defaults before each run, and the output echoes both the config and the values in force. A test shows an override reaching `npcMarketCaps`, and a smoke run with buys at 4 per window produced up to 8 buys per club a season.
- **(6) Messages:** progress, usage and error text are now 13 `marketSeasons.*` message IDs, in the source resource and all 12 locales.

**Fixtures moved by this round**
- `tests/fixtures/portable-v1.json` regenerated again.
- full-model-throughput candidate-rounds signature: `a05cbbd0c13eeb52` → `9322bc0149c21767`.
- calendar.progression-eng and season equivalence tests pass; the throughput test passes with the new signature (11 tests).

**Re-measured (8 seeds, 5 seasons; scout's bands reported, not gated)**

| Start | Fee moves in/out per top-flight club (p50) | Season-start XI lost (by fee) | Lower-division top-3 moving up | Division strength means |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lived:1951` | 3.0→1.8 / 2.6→1.1 — in the 2–4 band | 0.87→0.61, nearly all by fee — below 2–3 | about 5% (band 20–30%) | 88.5 / 84.1 / 82.7 / 81.5 |
| fresh 1995 | 7.0→6.1 / 7.0→5.5 — above 3–6, at the 2010 cap of 8 | 2.29→1.71 total, 2.22→1.68 by fee — top of the 1–2 band | 4–7% (band 40–60%) | 83.1 / 72.3 / 62.6 / 54.4 |

**Limits**
- **Re-bidding:** a pair can still be bid again on a later day of its window. That spends one of the day's bids, but it meets the same draws, as CLUB-52 r77 allows.
- **Edited outside the touches list:** the new registry file, the message resources and locale packs, and the regenerated fixtures.
- **Not run here:** `pnpm run verify:batch`, the portable contract test, and the integration files that live NPC transfer windows, left to the shared final gate.

findings.message: Candidates check only the total ceiling, ignoring the league's counted-player limit. Reproduced with an Italian third-tier club in 2021: 24 counted players became 26 after drawing two prodigies, exceeding its allowed 24 because this league has no youth exemption. Apply the counted/exempt arrival check used by intakeNpcYouth and choose another eligible club when registration would exceed the limit. Add a regression case for this league.

reviewHistory.summary: Found candidate-ranking and financial-display contract violations. All 70 focused tests, lint and i18n validation passed. No tracked files changed.

findings.message: Rounding slot gain changes CLUB-33's candidate order. With seed 'staff-signings', no manager pick and recruitment at step 5, the director bids for a player rated 55.73 at the slot while an affordable 56.27 candidate remains available: both gains round to 15. Rank by the unrounded gain and make the regression test compare actual slot values.

The displayed wage budget and contracts raise room ignore the additional reserve required by the raise. With income equal to current fixed costs, step 2, a balanced director and 10,000 minor units of available capital, contracts.left reports 1,666, but runwayTest rejects that raise; the actual maximum is 1,538. Derive the advertised room from the same commitment calculation used for acceptance.

A runway refusal still uses delegation.verdict.squadBudget, which claims fee plus one year's wage exceeds plan.left. Reproduced at step 2 with left=10,000, fee=5,000 and wage=1,500: rejection correctly follows the six-season runway, but the explanation falsely says 6,500 exceeds 10,000. Add a runway-specific refusal resource in every locale, retaining the historical resource for supported saves.

Confirmed delegation.offer.signings still says '7일마다', with the equivalent seven-day claim in all 12 locale packs. OfferAnswers also supplies the fixed upgrade count despite the new money-bar cap. Update this live explanation to describe three-day looks, the step's pending-bid limit and the expanded upgrade cap, using named parameters and translations throughout.

New fractional coverage and reserve values bypass the shared number formatters here and at line 108. sourceMessage stringifies them before localizeValue, so de-DE displays '3.5 Spielzeiten' and '0.25 Jahre' instead of localized decimal separators. Format these numbers at the presentation boundary with the shared decimal formatter.

planRoomAfterWage has no production callers after this lane; only tests exercise it. The refunded parameter chain also remains despite becoming a documented no-op. Consider removing these obsolete interfaces to avoid maintaining redundant budget APIs.

review.summary: The pinned submission has market and measurement contract violations. The worker reported passing task-tier checks and measurements; the shared final gate remains deferred to the coordinator.

findings.message: The tried set is recreated on every settlement day, so a buyer can bid for the same player again after a refusal in the same window. The test at npc-market.unit.test.ts:409 explicitly exercises this behavior, but T945 requires one bid per target per window. Prevent repeat bids within a window while preserving the specified seeded draws and bid cap.

XI losses are captured before liveHistory performs the season close. A season-start starter who retires, is released, or returns from a loan at that close is therefore omitted from the total XI losses reported for the season. Capture losses after the close while retaining the season-start club identities, and verify the resulting measurement used by T945.

The snapshot key replaces every non-alphanumeric seed character with an underscore without retaining or checking the original seed. For example, seed prefixes 'a/' and 'a_' produce the same filename for seed 0, so a later lived run can silently load the other seed's world despite a valid checksum. Encode or hash the complete seed in the key and verify distinct seeds cannot reuse a snapshot.

The harness rejects every --owner argument, although T944 specifies an owner world when --owner <club id> is supplied. Implement that start mode so the requested occasional owner-world measurements can run, or hand the scope gap back for a planning decision.

리뷰 지적(P2)을 고쳤습니다. 신동 배치가 이제 리그의 등록 인원 제한(CLUB-44)을 지킵니다.

- **문제:** 후보 클럽을 고를 때 전체 40명 상한만 보고, 리그가 실제로 세는 선수 수 제한은 보지 않았습니다. 그래서 유소년 면제가 없는 리그에서 제한을 넘길 수 있었습니다.
- **수정 (`packages/engine/src/prodigies.ts`):** 신동(14세, 아카데미 출신)이 그 클럽 규칙에서 면제 대상이 아니고 이미 허용 인원이 찼다면 그 클럽을 후보에서 뺍니다. 그러면 추첨은 다른 클럽으로 갑니다. 포지션은 클럽을 정한 뒤에 뽑기 때문에, 판정할 때는 필드 플레이어로 가정합니다.
- **회귀 테스트:** 2021년 이탈리아 3부 클럽(등록 24명 제한, 유소년 면제 없음)으로 확인합니다. 24명이 찬 상태에서는 신동이 오지 않고, 23명일 때도 24명을 넘지 않습니다. 수정을 잠시 빼고 돌리면 이 테스트가 실패하는 것도 확인했습니다.
- **검사:** `vibe check --tier task` 통과 — typecheck, lint, format, i18n, 영향받은 단위 테스트 1430개(tree 3e031a69). prodigies.test.ts는 8/8입니다.
- **다시 돌리지 않은 것:** 이전 측정과 통합 테스트는 이번 수정 전에 한 것입니다. 수정은 제한을 넘는 클럽을 후보에서 빼는 것뿐이라 다시 돌리지 않았고, 이 내용을 T947 결과에 적었습니다.

findings.message: Facility levels follow the old division at the season close because booksClose runs before applyPromotion in season.ts. A promoted or relegated club therefore starts its new division with levels adjusted against its previous target, and the new target is not applied until the following close. This can even move a level in the wrong direction during relegation. Apply the level adjustment after promotion using the new division while retaining the closing season’s financial calculation, and cover the real season-close ordering.

A prodigy placed in the owner’s academy at the 1938 close or during a skipped war summer receives no development or academy decisions during the gap. In particular, a prodigy drawn for 1939 reaches the 1946 restart aged 21 and is released by seasonAcademy without ever training or having a chance to be promoted. NPC prodigies develop at each skipped close. Handle owner-academy prodigies through the war gap so their development and eligibility do not disappear, and verify a placement across the 1939–1946 transition.

dispatch.summary:
All six review findings (correction c08fa13c) are fixed, and the task-tier checks pass.

1. **Upgrade candidate order (P2):** upgrade candidates are now ranked by their exact slot gain, not a rounded one. A player rated 55.73 at the slot no longer ties with one rated 56.27. The reach-ranking test now compares actual slot values.
2. **Raise room ignored the extra reserve (P2):** the wage bill the cash can carry and the room for raises now come from the same calculation the acceptance check uses, so the raise's added reserve is counted. A new test pins your example: income equal to fixed costs, 아껴서 and 10,000 of capital gives 1,538. That raise passes, and 1,539 fails.
3. **Misleading refusal message (P2):** signing refusals now say what actually failed: the wage bill, a fee plus seasons of planned loss beyond the cash, a planned loss at 최소한만, or a fee beyond the cash. There are four new message IDs, translated in all 12 locale packs. The old 'fundedWages' and 'squadBudget' messages stay for saved prose.
4. **"7일마다" copy (P2):** 'delegation.offer.signings' is replaced by 'delegation.offer.looks', which states the 3-day looks, the pending bids allowed at the current step and the money limit set by the runway test. At 넉넉히 and 아낌없이 a new 'delegation.offer.upgradesBar' describes the raised upgrade cap. All 12 locale packs are updated.
   - The look interval and pending-bid counts now live in one place, `RECRUITMENT_LOOKS` in delegation-info.ts. `SIGNING_CONFIG` copies them in, and the page reads the count through `stance.pending`.
5. **Number formatting (P2):** the seasons-covered figure and the reserve years in DelegationPlan now go through the shared `decimal` formatter, so de-DE shows "3,5".
6. **Obsolete APIs (P3):** removed `planRoomAfterWage`, `availableCapital`, `plannedLoss` and the no-op `refunded` parameter chain. Tests now read `delegatePlan(...).capital` and `runwayTest` instead.

**Checks:**
- **Task tier:** `vibe check --tier task --diff-base 1b484e79 --task T949` passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n, and 2660/2660 affected unit tests.
- **Affected files:** 15 unit and integration files passed, 199/199, including signings, contracts, transfers stance and incoming, scout-search and delegation.
- **Day-loop equivalence:** calendar.progression-eng, season and full-model-throughput all pass; no fixture moved.

**Not re-run:** the 1951 and 2005 reference careers. The ranking fix should only reorder near-tied candidates, so I don't expect the totals to move much, but that is unmeasured. The browser journeys are still left to the coordinator's CI.

Both task results now carry a note describing this correction.

findings.message: The reach-wide candidate search still applies the shortlist's age and ability bands. For example, at recruitment step 5 it excludes players younger than 26 and those above the ability ceiling, even when they are geographically within the scout's reach and are the best affordable upgrade. CLUB-33 requires ranking everyone within that reach after the manager's pick, while ECON-16 says the setting shapes the shortlist draw. Separate the reach-wide pool from the shortlist filters and verify ranking with an otherwise eligible player outside those bands.

The new eight-move limit can end a look with no pending bids and unfilled needs: immediate free-agent signings and refusals each consume a move, so after eight such approaches the director waits for a later look even when another candidate is available. CLUB-33 requires the look to continue until the pending-bid limit is reached or no move can be made. Remove the arbitrary cap or make termination follow those conditions, and cover more than eight immediate approaches.

Changing wagePressure to runway-based levels leaves the sale-answer consumer reporting the old income-share thresholds. A sale can now be discounted because cash cannot cover planned losses while its report says wages exceed a sales line by 10 percentage points, a line that no longer exists. Update the live sale-answer explanations to describe the runway condition, retaining the historical resources for saved prose; coordinate this change with T945, which owns that consumer.

The required two-season reference-career results were measured before the correction, not on commit 029f8fd. The correction changes candidate ordering, which can alter later signings, sales and cash through the simulation, so the recorded direction cannot establish the acceptance result for this candidate. findings.message: The reach-wide candidate search still applies the shortlist's age and ability bands. Remove the arbitrary cap or make termination follow those conditions, and cover more than eight immediate approaches.

dispatch.summary:
리뷰에서 지적된 두 건(P2)을 모두 고쳤고, 태스크 단계 검사와 영향받는 통합 테스트가 통과했습니다.

**T946: 승격·강등 뒤 시설 레벨이 새 리그를 따르도록 수정**
- 문제: 레벨 이동이 장부 마감 안에서 일어나 승격·강등보다 먼저 실행됐습니다. 그래서 승격·강등한 클럽이 한 시즌 동안 이전 리그의 목표를 따랐습니다.
- 수정: 장부 마감(`investLevels`)에서는 그 시즌의 투자만 기록합니다(진척도, 시즌당 한 레벨까지, 임시 플래그 `levels.invested`). 실제 레벨 이동(`followLevels`)은 `applyPromotion` 다음에 오는 `closeNpcSummer`에서 다음 시즌 리그의 목표를 향해 한 레벨씩 일어납니다. 전쟁기 여름에는 움직이지 않습니다.
- 임시 플래그 때문에 contracts의 types와 schema에도 선택 필드가 하나 추가됐습니다.
- 테스트: books.test에서 "장부만으로는 레벨이 안 움직이고, 이동은 새 리그 기준이며, 강등 뒤에는 한 레벨씩 내려감"을 확인합니다. npc-careers.test에서 "실제 여름 마감에서 승격 뒤 +1, 전쟁기 여름에는 변화 없음"을 확인합니다.

**T947: 전쟁 공백기에 구단주 아카데미로 신동이 가지 않도록 수정**
- 문제: 전쟁으로 건너뛰는 시즌(1938 마감의 1939 추첨과 1940–1945 여름)에 구단주 아카데미로 간 신동은 훈련도 승격도 못 하고, 1946 재개 때 21세로 방출됐습니다.
- 수정: 이런 시즌에는 구단주 아카데미를 후보에서 빼고, 구단주 없는 클럽에 배치합니다. 이 클럽들의 스쿼드는 건너뛴 여름마다 성장합니다. 1946 추첨부터는 다시 구단주 아카데미도 후보입니다.
- 회귀 테스트: 우리 아카데미 가중치를 6:1로 높여도 1939–1945에는 한 명도 오지 않고, 1946 이후에는 옵니다.

**검사 결과**
- `vibe check --tier task` 통과: typecheck, lint, format, i18n, 영향받는 단위 테스트 1586개(tree 814106fc).
- 통합 테스트 24/24 통과: calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput, wartime, wartime-employment, persisted-world.integration, history.

**T916 시드 1930→1951 재측정**
- 1946 개막 스쿼드는 평균 22.2명, 최대 28명입니다.
- 1951년 리그별 평균 전력은 75.9/65.5/57.7/52.8로, 2–4부 기준선보다 낮습니다. 리그 평균 ±3 밴드에 든 칸은 147칸 중 30칸(T946 단독 측정 때는 54칸)입니다.
- 원인은 전쟁기 유스 영입을 기본 인원 보충까지로 묶은 T947 변경으로 보이며, 상수 조정은 T950 몫으로 결과에 적어 두었습니다.

빌드, 전체 스위트, 브라우저 테스트는 최종 공동 게이트와 CI에 넘깁니다.

dispatch.summary:
All four review findings are fixed, and the task-tier check passed (typecheck, lint, format, i18n, and 2693 affected unit tests in 301 files; format failed once and passed after prettier).
(1) T945, one bid per target per window: each buyer now meets each target on one seeded settlement day of the window, keyed `<seed>:npc-bid-day:<year>:<window>:<buyer>:<player>` and chosen among the days the era caps open to bids (`npcBidDay`). This adds no saved state and keeps the window-keyed bid, sale and terms draws and the bid caps. The re-bid unit test now asserts one sale draw and one terms draw per window across all six settlement days. The mechanics tests pin the meeting day.
(2) The XI losses each season are now read after the season close, against the clubs the starters began the season at. In lived 1951, top-flight XI lost per club goes from 0.87 to 1.83, and the part lost by fee comes into band at 0.79–1.15.
(3) Snapshot names now carry the sha256 of the complete seed, with a unit test showing that the seeds `a/0` and `a_0` stay apart.
(4) `--owner <club id>` with `--owner-tier` (default oil) takes the club over with every responsibility delegated. A run whose owner career ends stops with a message instead of looping. An owner smoke run of 3 seasons took 112 s.
The day-loop equivalence tests pass after two regenerated fixtures: the throughput candidateRounds signature (9322bc… → 9581b4…) and the portable golden. Both 8-seed, 5-season measurements were re-run and recorded in T945's result alongside T944's notes.

review.summary: The prior review corrections are present, but the NPC market still excludes eligible targets in ways that violate T945’s buyer-selection contract. Worker task-tier checks and measurements were reviewed; the coordinator host owns the final gate.

findings.message: A buyer can meet a target only on one randomly assigned settlement day. If its need or funding becomes available after that day, it cannot bid for that player during the rest of the window, even when he is its best reachable target. The same restriction lets a lower-stature buyer acquire a player before a higher-stature interested buyer’s assigned day. T945 requires selection on each settlement day and WORLD-16 gives a contested player to the higher-stature club. Track window attempts without excluding untried targets on later days, and cover a need opening after the first settlement and competing buyers.

The candidate index discards everyone above an estimated regular’s affordable level plus six and stops after 24 main-OVR entries per division before ranking by slot gain. An affordable older player above that estimate, or a better slot fit below those 24 entries, is never considered even when he is the best reachable target. T945 requires buyers to choose by slot gain within reach and means. Preserve the indexed search while ensuring eligible candidates can compete on actual affordability and slot rating, with coverage for both boundaries.

reviewHistory.summary: The pinned submission has market and measurement contract violations. The worker reported passing task-tier checks and measurements; the shared final gate remains deferred to the coordinator.

findings.message: The tried set is recreated on every settlement day, so a buyer can bid for the same player again after a refusal in the same window. The test at npc-market.unit.test.ts:409 explicitly exercises this behavior, but T945 requires one bid per target per window. Prevent repeat bids within a window while preserving the specified seeded draws and bid cap.

XI losses are captured before liveHistory performs the season close. A season-start starter who retires, is released, or returns from a loan at that close is therefore omitted from the total XI losses reported for the season. Capture losses after the close while retaining the season-start club identities, and verify the resulting measurement used by T945.

The snapshot key replaces every non-alphanumeric seed character with an underscore without retaining or checking the original seed. For example, seed prefixes 'a/' and 'a_' produce the same filename for seed 0, so a later lived run can silently load the other seed's world despite a valid checksum. Encode or hash the complete seed in the key and verify distinct seeds cannot reuse a snapshot.

The harness rejects every --owner argument, although T944 specifies an owner world when --owner <club id> is supplied. Implement that start mode so the requested occasional owner-world measurements can run, or hand the scope gap back for a planning decision.

dispatch.summary:
Correction 2546fd3c는 T948과 T949에 모두 반영했습니다. 지적 4건을 고쳤고 task-tier 검사(typecheck, lint, format, i18n, 영향 유닛 2661/2661)를 통과했습니다.

(1) 스카우트 도달 범위 전체 후보: `reachOffers`(scout-search.ts)가 검색의 나이·능력 범위와 상관없이 스카우트 도달 범위 안의 선수를 모두 담습니다. 이 범위는 이제 스카우트 명단에만 적용됩니다(ECON-16).
- 새 signings 테스트: 나이 범위보다 어리고 능력 상한보다 높은 자유계약 선수가 명단에는 없지만 도달 범위에는 들어가고, 아낌없이 업그레이드로 영입됩니다.
- scout-search 테스트는 바뀐 동작에 맞게 고쳤습니다.
- 1950년 커리어 월드에서 도달 범위 후보 1,034명을 만드는 데 3.5 ms가 걸렸습니다.

(2) 한 번 볼 때 8번이던 이동 상한(`movesPerLook`)을 없앴습니다. 이제 대기 중 입찰이 단계별 수에 닿거나 더 할 수 있는 이동이 없을 때 끝납니다. 이동마다 그 선수에게 입찰 기록이 남고 같은 창에서 다시 시도하지 않으므로 반드시 끝납니다.
- 새 테스트: 즉시 거절하는 자유계약 선수 10명을 거친 뒤, 같은 확인 안에서 다른 구단 선수 입찰이 대기 한도(3건)까지 이어집니다.

(3) 매각 판단 보고 문구가 실패한 적자 런웨이 조건을 말합니다.
- 새 메시지 ID 3개를 원문과 12개 언어 팩 모두에 추가했습니다: `market.sale.runway.over`, `market.sale.runway.far`, `market.sale.runway.income`. 예전 `market.sale.wages.*`는 저장된 문장 때문에 그대로 두었습니다.
- `wagePressure`가 단계의 runway도 함께 돌려줍니다.
- sale-answer.ts는 T945 소관 파일이지만 리뷰어 요청에 따라 최소한만 고쳤습니다. 'wages' 항목의 메시지 줄, 선택 필드 `runwaySeasons`, 그 대입 한 줄입니다. npc-market 레인의 수정과 겹치는 부분이 없음을 diff로 확인했습니다.

(4) 기준 커리어 두 개를 수정된 작업 트리에서 다시 쟀고 결과를 T949에 적었습니다. 커밋된 후보 자체에서 잰 것은 아니며, 비교 기준은 bad91b7c입니다.
- 1951년: 영입 28 / 매각 24(이전 15/18). 주전 11명 평균이 61.1 → 70.1 → 84.8 → 88.7 → 88.8로 이적시장 창마다 올랐고, 가장 비싼 영입은 OVR 91–93입니다.
- 2005년: 영입 33 / 매각 23(이전 14/18). 주전 평균이 61.0 → 67.8 → 70.2 → 74.0 → 77.4로 올랐고, 가장 비싼 영입은 £8.83M(OVR 90)입니다.

통합 테스트 17개 파일을 한 번 돌렸습니다. day-loop 동등성 테스트(calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput)를 포함해 1건을 빼고 모두 통과했고, 다시 만든 fixture는 없습니다. 실패한 1건은 예전 범위 동작을 고정해 둔 scout-search 단언이었습니다. 고친 뒤 유닛 실행과 task-tier 검사에서 통과했습니다. 브라우저 여정은 coordinator의 CI 게이트로 넘깁니다.

findings.message: At sales step 1, any planned loss makes wagePressure level 2 because the plan permits no loss, even if the club has ample cash. The untouchable-sale explanation nevertheless says cash cannot cover half the allowed seasons, although there are no allowed seasons. The recruitment, contracts and sales plan-over explanations similarly describe insufficient cash at step 1. Use income-based explanations when the runway is zero, and cover that case in the affected reports.

A positive coverage below 0.1 seasons is rounded down to zero in delegatePlan, so coversLine selects coversNone and tells the user there is no cash available even when plan.capital is positive. Distinguish zero capital from positive coverage that rounds to zero, and display an accurate coverage or less-than-0.1 message.

reviewHistory.summary: Found candidate-ranking and financial-display contract violations. All 70 focused tests, lint and i18n validation passed. No tracked files changed.

findings.message: Rounding slot gain changes CLUB-33's candidate order. With seed 'staff-signings', no manager pick and recruitment at step 5, the director bids for a player rated 55.73 at the slot while an affordable 56.27 candidate remains available: both gains round to 15. Rank by the unrounded gain and make the regression test compare actual slot values.

The displayed wage budget and contracts raise room ignore the additional reserve required by the raise. With income equal to current fixed costs, step 2, a balanced director and 10,000 minor units of available capital, contracts.left reports 1,666, but runwayTest rejects that raise; the actual maximum is 1,538. Derive the advertised room from the same commitment calculation used for acceptance.

A runway refusal still uses delegation.verdict.squadBudget, which claims fee plus one year's wage exceeds plan.left. Reproduced at step 2 with left=10,000, fee=5,000 and wage=1,500: rejection correctly follows the six-season runway, but the explanation falsely says 6,500 exceeds 10,000. Add a runway-specific refusal resource in every locale, retaining the historical resource for supported saves.

Confirmed delegation.offer.signings still says '7일마다', with the equivalent seven-day claim in all 12 locale packs. OfferAnswers also supplies the fixed upgrade count despite the new money-bar cap. Update this live explanation to describe three-day looks, the step's pending-bid limit and the expanded upgrade cap, using named parameters and translations throughout.

New fractional coverage and reserve values bypass the shared number formatters here and at line 108. sourceMessage stringifies them before localizeValue, so de-DE displays '3.5 Spielzeiten' and '0.25 Jahre' instead of localized decimal separators. Format these numbers at the presentation boundary with the shared decimal formatter.

planRoomAfterWage has no production callers after this lane; only tests exercise it. The refunded parameter chain also remains despite becoming a documented no-op. Consider removing these obsolete interfaces to avoid maintaining redundant budget APIs.

reviewHistory.summary: The prior review corrections are present, but the submission still violates recruitment and sale-explanation contracts. The reference-career measurements also predate the assigned commit; the coordinator host should run the final gate.

findings.message: The reach-wide candidate search still applies the shortlist's age and ability bands. For example, at recruitment step 5 it excludes players younger than 26 and those above the ability ceiling, even when they are geographically within the scout's reach and are the best affordable upgrade. CLUB-33 requires ranking everyone within that reach after the manager's pick, while ECON-16 says the setting shapes the shortlist draw. Separate the reach-wide pool from the shortlist filters and verify ranking with an otherwise eligible player outside those bands.

The new eight-move limit can end a look with no pending bids and unfilled needs: immediate free-agent signings and refusals each consume a move, so after eight such approaches the director waits for a later look even when another candidate is available. CLUB-33 requires the look to continue until the pending-bid limit is reached or no move can be made. Remove the arbitrary cap or make termination follow those conditions, and cover more than eight immediate approaches.

Changing wagePressure to runway-based levels leaves the sale-answer consumer reporting the old income-share thresholds. A sale can now be discounted because cash cannot cover planned losses while its report says wages exceed a sales line by 10 percentage points, a line that no longer exists. Update the live sale-answer explanations to describe the runway condition, retaining the historical resources for saved prose; coordinate this change with T945, which owns that consumer.

The required two-season reference-career results were measured before the correction, not on commit 029f8fd. The correction changes candidate ordering, which can alter later signings, sales and cash through the simulation, so the recorded direction cannot establish the acceptance result for this candidate. Have the coordinator host measure both reference careers on the pinned candidate and record the results before the final gate.

dispatch.summary:
Correction 6a392ece와 coordinator 결정을 T948/T949에 반영했고, task-tier 검사(`vibe check --tier task --diff-base a696eb95 --task T949`)를 통과했습니다. 영향 유닛은 2661/2661, i18n은 12개 언어 6957개 메시지입니다.

**coordinator 결정**
- 매각 판단 보고 문구는 T951로 넘어가서, sale-answer.ts의 runway 문구와 `market.sale.runway.*` 3개 ID(원문과 12개 팩)를 기준 상태로 되돌렸습니다. 함께 넣었던 delegation 테스트도 뺐습니다.
- 그래서 T951이 들어가기 전까지 실제 매각 판단 보고는 예전 '수입의 N%' 매각 기준선 문구를 그대로 보여 줍니다.
- `wagePressure`의 `runway` 필드는 delegation.ts 쪽이라 남겼고, 기존 테스트에서 값을 확인합니다.
- 기준 커리어 재측정은 다시 돌리지 않았습니다. T950에서 coordinator가 통합 후보로 잽니다. 두 넘김 모두 task result limits에 적었습니다.
- 지적 (1) 스카우트 도달 범위 전체 후보와 (2) 고정 8회 상한 없는 확인 종료는 a696eb95에 들어간 그대로 유지합니다.

**지적 1: 1단계(적자 허용 없음)의 보고 문구 (transfers.ts, delegation.ts, DelegationPlan.tsx)**
1단계에서 계획 적자가 생기면, 보고가 '보유 자금이 허용 기간을 버티지 못함'이 아니라 지출이 계획 수입을 넘었다고 말합니다. 새 ID 5개를 12개 팩 모두에 넣었습니다.
- `delegation.sale.incomeUntouchable`: 이적 불가 선수 가격 −25%p 단계
- `delegation.plan.salesPressedIncome` / `salesCalmIncome`: 매각 계획 줄과 계획 문장
- `delegation.flow.recruitmentShortIncome` / `contractsShortIncome`: 영입·계약 계획 문장

**지적 2: 현금 커버 시즌 표시 (DelegationPlan.tsx)**
보유 자금이 있는데 커버가 0.1시즌 미만이면 '쓸 수 있는 현금 없음' 대신 새 `delegation.runway.coversLittle`('현금으로 0.1시즌분 미만')을 보여 줍니다. '쓸 수 있는 현금 없음'은 보유 자금이 0일 때만 나옵니다. 이 판정은 테스트하려고 `coverageLine`으로 분리했습니다.

**추가 테스트**
- transfers.stance (integration, 4/4 통과): 1단계에서 현금이 넉넉해도 가격이 내려가고, 사유에 수입 문구가 나옵니다.
- delegation (19 통과): 1단계 매각 계획 줄 확인.
- DelegationPlan.test.ts (새 파일): 0.1시즌 미만과 자금 0을 구분하는지 확인.

**남은 것**
- day-loop 동등성 테스트(calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput)는 이번 수정 뒤 다시 돌리지 않았습니다. 최근 통과는 2546fd3c 트리였고, 이번에 엔진에서 바뀐 것은 보고 문구 선택뿐입니다.

- 브라우저 여정은 coordinator의 Chromium CI로 넘깁니다.

review.summary: The prior explanation fixes are present, and the worker’s task-tier checks passed on the pinned commit. Two contract violations remain in the runway calculation and negotiator retries. The coordinator retains the final integration and reference-career gate.

findings.message: ECON-33 defines the reserve from current annual fixed costs, then tests the planned loss after the commitment against that available capital. Adding the proposed wage to the reserve prematurely rejects affordable signings and raises. For example, at step 2 with a balanced director, current costs equal to income and 10,000 above the current reserve, a fee-free raise of 1,666 has a six-season loss of 9,996 and should pass; this calculation rejects it because it also reserves half the proposed raise. Calculate the reserve from current costs and use the post-commitment costs for the planned loss; align the displayed wage room and tests with that rule.

When multiple negotiator bids are rejected on the same day and capacity is available, this selects and retries only one. The remaining rejected bids are delayed, and subsequent ordinary moves can fill the pending limit before they are retried. CLUB-41 requires each negotiator’s raised bid the day after its answer. Process all due retries within the applicable pending limit before making ordinary moves, and cover simultaneous rejections.

reviewHistory.summary: Found candidate-ranking and financial-display contract violations. All 70 focused tests, lint and i18n validation passed. No tracked files changed.

findings.message: Rounding slot gain changes CLUB-33's candidate order. With seed 'staff-signings', no manager pick and recruitment at step 5, the director bids for a player rated 55.73 at the slot while an affordable 56.27 candidate remains available: both gains round to 15. Rank by the unrounded gain and make the regression test compare actual slot values.

The displayed wage budget and contracts raise room ignore the additional reserve required by the raise. With income equal to current fixed costs, step 2, a balanced director and 10,000 minor units of available capital, contracts.left reports 1,666, but runwayTest rejects that raise; the actual maximum is 1,538. Derive the advertised room from the same commitment calculation used for acceptance.

A runway refusal still uses delegation.verdict.squadBudget, which claims fee plus one year's wage exceeds plan.left. Reproduced at step 2 with left=10,000, fee=5,000 and wage=1,500: rejection correctly follows the six-season runway, but the explanation falsely says 6,500 exceeds 10,000. Add a runway-specific refusal resource in every locale, retaining the historical resource for supported saves.

Confirmed delegation.offer.signings still says '7일마다', with the equivalent seven-day claim in all 12 locale packs. OfferAnswers also supplies the fixed upgrade count despite the new money-bar cap. Update this live explanation to describe three-day looks, the step's pending-bid limit and the expanded upgrade cap, using named parameters and translations throughout.

New fractional coverage and reserve values bypass the shared number formatters here and at line 108. sourceMessage stringifies them before localizeValue, so de-DE displays '3.5 Spielzeiten' and '0.25 Jahre' instead of localized decimal separators. Format these numbers at the presentation boundary with the shared decimal formatter.

planRoomAfterWage has no production callers after this lane; only tests exercise it. The refunded parameter chain also remains despite becoming a documented no-op. Consider removing these obsolete interfaces to avoid maintaining redundant budget APIs.

reviewHistory.summary: The prior review corrections are present, but the submission still violates recruitment and sale-explanation contracts. The reference-career measurements also predate the assigned commit; the coordinator host should run the final gate.

findings.message: The reach-wide candidate search still applies the shortlist's age and ability bands. For example, at recruitment step 5 it excludes players younger than 26 and those above the ability ceiling, even when they are geographically within the scout's reach and are the best affordable upgrade. CLUB-33 requires ranking everyone within that reach after the manager's pick, while ECON-16 says the setting shapes the shortlist draw. Separate the reach-wide pool from the shortlist filters and verify ranking with an otherwise eligible player outside those bands.

The new eight-move limit can end a look with no pending bids and unfilled needs: immediate free-agent signings and refusals each consume a move, so after eight such approaches the director waits for a later look even when another candidate is available. CLUB-33 requires the look to continue until the pending-bid limit is reached or no move can be made. Remove the arbitrary cap or make termination follow those conditions, and cover more than eight immediate approaches.

Changing wagePressure to runway-based levels leaves the sale-answer consumer reporting the old income-share thresholds. A sale can now be discounted because cash cannot cover planned losses while its report says wages exceed a sales line by 10 percentage points, a line that no longer exists. Update the live sale-answer explanations to describe the runway condition, retaining the historical resources for saved prose; coordinate this change with T945, which owns that consumer.

The required two-season reference-career results were measured before the correction, not on commit 029f8fd. The correction changes candidate ordering, which can alter later signings, sales and cash through the simulation, so the recorded direction cannot establish the acceptance result for this candidate. Have the coordinator host measure both reference careers on the pinned candidate and record the results before the final gate.

reviewHistory.summary: The reach-wide search and look termination corrections are present, and the worker’s task-tier checks passed on the assigned commit. Two runway explanations still misstate the club’s finances. The coordinator retains the final integration and reference-career gate.

findings.message: At sales step 1, any planned loss makes wagePressure level 2 because the plan permits no loss, even if the club has ample cash. The untouchable-sale explanation nevertheless says cash cannot cover half the allowed seasons, although there are no allowed seasons. The recruitment, contracts and sales plan-over explanations similarly describe insufficient cash at step 1. Use income-based explanations when the runway is zero, and cover that case in the affected reports.

A positive coverage below 0.1 seasons is rounded down to zero in delegatePlan, so coversLine selects coversNone and tells the user there is no cash available even when plan.capital is positive. Distinguish zero capital from positive coverage that rounds to zero, and display an accurate coverage or less-than-0.1 message.

dispatch.summary:
Review c7941f4e를 반영했습니다(P2 2건). 작업 트리에 반영만 했고 커밋은 하지 않았습니다.

1) 구단주 유스와 전쟁 공백 (prodigies.ts:56)
- 전쟁 시즌에 구단주 클럽을 신동 후보에서 빼던 조건을 없앴습니다. 이제 매 여름 일반 가중치로 배치합니다(WORLD-18).
- crossWar(wartime.ts)는 건너뛴 여름마다 구단주 유스의 신동에게 한 시즌치 발달(developAnnually, 18세까지 ×3)을 줍니다. 그 여름 close보다 먼저 적용하므로, 전쟁 전부터 있던 신동도 포함됩니다.
- seasonAcademy(academy.ts)는 공백 동안 21세를 넘긴 신동을 1946 재개 시점에 방출하지 않습니다. 재개 시즌 동안 남겨 승격할 기회를 주고, 승격되지 않으면 그 시즌 마감 때 떠납니다(CLUB-16).
- 회귀 테스트:
  - 1938/39에 14세인 신동이 1938→1946 crossWar에서 OVR +15를 넘게 성장하고, 1946에는 남았다가 1947에 방출됩니다.
  - 전쟁 시즌에 상대 스쿼드가 가득 차 있으면 신동은 우리 유스로 갑니다.

2) 전쟁 여름의 스쿼드 초과 (npc-careers.ts:314)
- WORLD-16의 '정원까지만 보충'과 T947의 '매 전쟁 여름 신동 추첨'을 함께 만족하도록 맞췄습니다. 이 해석은 제가 정한 것이고 coordinator의 스펙 결정을 확인하지는 못했습니다.
  - 추첨은 매 여름 그대로 합니다.
  - 전쟁 여름에는 정원(22) 미만인 NPC 스쿼드만 후보로 하고, 보충보다 먼저 추첨합니다. 그래서 신동은 정원을 채우는 보충 인원 중 하나가 되고, 정원을 넘기지 않습니다.
  - 정상 시즌은 기존대로 유스 입단 뒤에 추첨합니다.
- 회귀 테스트:
  - 꽉 찬 스쿼드는 전쟁 신동을 받지 않습니다.
  - 한 자리가 비면 최대 1명만 받습니다.
  - closeNpcSummer(…, false)를 7번 돌리면 모든 스쿼드가 정확히 22로 끝나고, 매 여름 추첨도 일어납니다.
- npc-careers.test의 7개 전쟁 여름 케이스는 그동안 쌓인 신동을 입단으로 읽고 있었습니다. 은퇴 1명에 보충 1명, 스쿼드 22를 확인하도록 바꿨습니다.

검증
- `vibe check --tier task --diff-base 11717bdb --task T947` 통과(tree c9aa403f, affected units 1588/1588). 처음 실행은 포맷 검사에서 실패했고, 두 파일에 prettier를 적용한 뒤 다시 돌려 통과했습니다.
- 통합 테스트 24/24 통과: calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput, wartime, wartime-employment, persisted-world.integration, history.
- portable contract 6/6 통과. golden과 digest는 바뀌지 않았습니다.
- T916 시드 1930→1946 재측정: 1946 스쿼드 평균 22.2, 최대 28(1938 정상 시즌 마감의 전체 입단 때문). 티어 평균은 75.4/66.8/60.2/56.1입니다.
- T947 result에 정정 내용과 측정값을 기록했습니다.

남은 범위
- 일반(신동이 아닌) 구단주 유스와 구단주 1군의 전쟁 공백 처리는 기존 동작 그대로입니다.

review.summary: The prior wartime corrections restore owner-academy placement and limit squad refills, but two T947 contracts remain unmet. The worker’s task-tier checks passed on the pinned commit; the coordinator owns the final verification gate.

findings.message: In a skipped summer, full NPC squads are excluded from placement. If every squad is at or above the standing size and there is no owner academy with room, the candidate pool is empty and the draw creates no prodigy; with only one available place, a two-player draw creates only one. The worker’s new test explicitly demonstrates the empty-pool case. WORLD-18 and T947 require one or two prodigies every summer, while WORLD-16 limits wartime refills. Obtain the coordinator’s specification decision for this conflict and implement and verify the selected behavior, including an ownerless full world.

Annual development selects the prodigy multiplier using context.year, but both skipped-summer callers pass the following year. A prodigy aged 17 in the skipped season is therefore evaluated as 18 and receives ordinary growth for that entire season, even though PLAYER-15 requires triple growth until 18. This affects both NPC squad players and owner-academy prodigies. Use the age of the season being developed for the multiplier and cover the age-17-to-18 wartime boundary.

findings.message: Facility levels follow the old division at the season close because booksClose runs before applyPromotion in season.ts. A promoted or relegated club therefore starts its new division with levels adjusted against its previous target, and the new target is not applied until the following close. This can even move a level in the wrong direction during relegation. Apply the level adjustment after promotion using the new division while retaining the closing season’s financial calculation, and cover the real season-close ordering.

A prodigy placed in the owner’s academy at the 1938 close or during a skipped war summer receives no development or academy decisions during the gap. In particular, a prodigy drawn for 1939 reaches the 1946 restart aged 21 and is released by seasonAcademy without ever training or having a chance to be promoted. NPC prodigies develop at each skipped close. Handle owner-academy prodigies through the war gap so their development and eligibility do not disappear, and verify a placement across the 1939–1946 transition.

findings.message: Excluding the owner's club from every 1939–1945 draw changes the required weighted placement: WORLD-18 and T947 include the owner's club each summer. decision: How should 'one bid per target per window' (from T945's implementation notes) work between clubs nobody owns? The reviewer rejects the coordinator's single seeded meeting day per buyer-player pair: a need or funds that open later in the window never reach that player, and a lower-stature buyer can sign a player before a higher-stature buyer's day comes. Meanwhile CLUB-52 r77 and CLUB-53 already say 'a pair asked again in the window meets the same spread', which assumes re-asking is allowed. Saved state is ruled out.

dispatch.summary:
Finding 2 is fixed and the task-tier check passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n and 1,453 affected unit tests (lint failed once on an unused import and passed after it was removed).
The buyer's search now starts at a wage ceiling: the highest OVR whose market wage, at the cheapest age (14 or 41) with no promise, fits the buyer's headroom. It reads down each indexed list and stops only when no remaining player could beat both the need's threshold and the targets already kept at that slot. The fixed 24-entry depth is gone. Each candidate is checked for affordability (his wage plus the lowest possible bid) without firing the wage-decision observer.
Two new unit tests cover the reviewer's boundaries. Both fail on the previous engine and pass now:
- An affordable 40-year-old rated 88 is bought, although the old estimate cut him off.
- A slot fit rated 82 is bought past 30 abler players who rate only 78.2 at that slot.
The day-loop equivalence tests pass (11) after regenerating the throughput signature (9581b43fe497276a → 8268a8e9573aa5ea) and tests/fixtures/portable-v1.json. Both 8-seed, 5-season measurements were re-run and recorded in T945's result. The bands barely moved, and fresh-1995 CPU time is unchanged at 322 s.
Finding 1 is blocked. The reviewer asks that a buyer can still bid on later settlement days, and that a higher-stature club is not beaten by a lower one's earlier meeting day. The current one seeded meeting day per buyer-player pair follows the coordinator's directive, and lifting it needs a decision only the planner can make. The code keeps the directed per-pair day for now.

dispatch.summary:
I fixed both review findings (bd209107), and the task-tier check passes on the uncommitted tree.

**F1 (T948, `delegation.ts`):** `runwayCheck` now keeps the reserve on current annual fixed costs, as ECON-33 says. A new commitment's wage only raises the planned loss; it no longer adds to the reserve as well. `wageRoom` follows from this, so the plan's carried wage bill and the room for raises also change. In the review's example (step 2, a 균형형 단장, income equal to fixed costs, 10,000 of capital), the raise room is now 1,666 and 1,667 fails. That replaces the earlier 1,538. I updated the test in `delegation.test.ts`, and the cash set-up in `signings.test.ts` no longer puts the wage into the reserve.

**F2 (T949, `signings.ts`):** each day, before any ordinary move, `staffSignings` now raises every negotiator bid that was refused on an earlier day: one per player, on his latest bid. It stops when the pending bids reach the step's count, and any left over wait for the next day. Off a regular look, the 단장 goes on to ordinary moves only when one of those haggles ended without a raise. A new test in `director-bidding.test.ts` refuses two bids on the same day at 아낌없이. It checks that both are raised to 95% the next day, ahead of ordinary moves.

**A failing integration test I also fixed:** `transfers.delegated.test.ts` already failed on 81046c88 and passes on the base 689ba861. With the lane's buying every 3 days from the scout's whole reach, seed `market-1`'s season gets 8 incoming bids and all are accepted, so there is no refusal to check. I moved the scenario to seed `market-3` (8 accepted, 2 refused) and left the assertions unchanged. That file is outside the tasks' touches.

**Checks run:**
- The task tier check (`vibe check --tier task --diff-base 81046c88 --task T949`) passed: typecheck, lint, format, i18n and 1419 affected unit tests.
- Integration tests run once:
  - Day-loop equivalence tests passed, and no fixture moved: calendar.progression-eng, season, full-model-throughput.
  - These also passed: signings, mediation-resolution, replacements, responsibility-routing, contracts, transfers.stance and transfers.delegated.
- I did not re-run the reference careers. The coordinator re-measures them on the integrated candidate in T950.
- Both task results are updated.

findings.message: The reach-wide candidate search still applies the shortlist's age and ability bands. For example, at recruitment step 5 it excludes players younger than 26 and those above the ability ceiling, even when they are geographically within the scout's reach and are the best affordable upgrade. The new eight-move limit can end a look with no pending bids and unfilled needs: immediate free-agent signings and refusals each consume a move, so after eight such approaches the director waits for a later look even when another candidate is available. CLUB-33 requires the look to continue until the pending-bid limit is reached or no move can be made. Remove the arbitrary cap or make termination follow those conditions, and cover more than eight immediate approaches.

Update the live sale-answer explanations to describe the runway condition, retaining the historical resources for saved prose; coordinate this change with T945, which owns that consumer.

findings.message: ECON-33 defines the reserve from current annual fixed costs, then tests the planned loss after the commitment against that available capital. Adding the proposed wage to the reserve prematurely rejects affordable signings and raises. For example, at step 2 with a balanced director, current costs equal to income and 10,000 above the current reserve, a fee-free raise of 1,666 has a six-season loss of 9,996 and should pass; this calculation rejects it because it also reserves half the proposed raise. Calculate the reserve from current costs and use the post-commitment costs for the planned loss; align the displayed wage room and tests with that rule.

When multiple negotiator bids are rejected on the same day and capacity is available, this selects and retries only one. The remaining rejected bids are delayed, and subsequent ordinary moves can fill the pending limit before they are retried. CLUB-41 requires each negotiator’s raised bid the day after its answer. Process all due retries within the applicable pending limit before making ordinary moves, and cover simultaneous rejections.

findings.message: Next-day negotiator retries can still be displaced by ordinary bids. When three haggles are rejected or counters declined on regular look day D, they are ineligible for retry until D+1, so the ordinary loop fills all three pending slots on D. On D+1 this guard returns before retrying any original player. Reproduced with the director-bids fixture, balanced temperament and recruitment step 5. Preserve capacity for scheduled haggles and add a regression that invokes staffSignings on both the answer day and the following day (CLUB-41).

One pending player removes an entire short-line need regardless of its deficit. shortLines emits one need per line, so two forwards against a minimum of four are treated as covered after only one forward bid. In a funded 3-5-2 case with two strong forwards, the look makes one short-FW bid followed by two DF upgrade bids while another affordable forward is still needed. Account for pending arrivals against count/minimum before advancing to upgrades, preserving CLUB-33's short-line priority.

Format this recognized numeric parameter at the presentation boundary while keeping saved source prose locale-independent, as required by ARCH-32.

findings.message: The tried set is recreated on every settlement day, so a buyer can bid for the same player again after a refusal in the same window. The test at npc-market.unit.test.ts:409 explicitly exercises this behavior, but T945 requires one bid per target per window. Prevent repeat bids within a window while preserving the specified seeded draws and bid cap.

XI losses are captured before liveHistory performs the season close. A season-start starter who retires, is released, or returns from a loan at that close is therefore omitted from the total XI losses reported for the season. Capture losses after the close while retaining the season-start club identities, and verify the resulting measurement used by T945.

The snapshot key replaces every non-alphanumeric seed character with an underscore without retaining or checking the original seed. findings.message: ECON-33 defines the reserve from current annual fixed costs, then tests the planned loss after the commitment against that available capital.
